how_to_apply: Applications are offline. The notice gives these steps:

Write the application on plain paper, giving full details as per the proforma enclosed with the notice. The proforma asks for the post applied for, Sr. No. of the post and discipline, full name and address, mobile number and email ID, date of birth, age on closing date, gender, caste and category (SC/ST/DT/NT/OBC/OPEN), educational qualification, experience, publications, other information and present employment.
Paste a self-attested passport size recent photo in the box on the proforma.

Pay the processing fee of Rs. 500/- (Rs. Five hundred only) through online mode to the account of "Comptroller, MPKV, Rahuri", Account No. 3335577362, Central Bank of India, Nandurbar, IFSC CODE CBIN0282185.
Write the NEFT details, bank, amount, UTR No. and date in item 14 of the proforma, and attach the payment receipt to the application form.
Attach attested Xerox copies of the required documents, sign the declaration and add the date and place.

Send the application to: Associate Dean, Govt. College of Agriculture, Nandurbar, Dhule Road, Tal., Dist. Nandurbar, Pin code 425-412 (MS), on or before 16 November 2026. The application may also be handed in during office hours.

Eligible candidates will be interviewed by a Selection Committee approved by the University. Candidates attend the interview at their own cost and must produce all original documents at the time of interview. Candidature will be rejected if they fail to do so. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.
important_instructions: Any type of act or indiscipline behaviour will be viewed seriously and the assignment will be terminated without any intimation to the candidate. Any false or incorrect statement in the application will make the candidate liable to appropriate action as may be decided by the university. Contact details printed in the notice: Phone 02564-299541 / 299626, Mob. No. 9922297268, Email [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About MPKV Medical Officer (Clock Hour Basis)
content_sections.text: Govt. College of Agriculture, Nandurbar is a college of Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri, a state agricultural university in Maharashtra. The college is on Dhule Road, Nandurbar, and the notice is issued by its Associate Dean, U. B. Hole. The Medical Officer is being engaged to look after the day-to-day health issues of the students and staff of this college.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 1 post in total. Its post table reads: The notice gives no category-wise reservation for the post.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice does not ask for any minimum experience. However, the application proforma has sections for work experience (institute, period and reason for leaving) and for publications (scientific, technical or popular), so candidates who have these should fill them in. The proforma also asks for the candidate's age on the closing date, but the notice prints no age limit. Candidates should check the eligibility conditions for the post in the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: MBBS or BAMS degree from recognized medical institute

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The Medical Officer (Clock Hour Basis) is paid Rs. 1500/- per hour upto maximum Rs. 25,000/- per month . The notice names no allowances. The terms printed in the notice are: The appointment will be purely temporary on contractual basis, initially for six (06) months. It can continue on satisfactory progress/performance. The candidate has to submit an undertaking on Rs. 100/- bond paper accepting all the terms and conditions prescribed. The appointment shall automatically terminate at any time on the joining of a person on regular establishment. The selected candidate must work on clock hour basis and for the full term. The appointment is a tenure appointment and is liable to be terminated at any time without assigning any reason. The candidate shall not have any right to claim permanency benefit in lieu of this contractual appointment.

content_sections.heading: MPKV Medical Officer (Clock Hour Basis) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the nature of work as: To perform the duties regarding health issues of students / staff and other duties directed by the Associate Dean of this College from time to time.

faq.question: Q1. How many Medical Officer posts are advertised by MPKV at Nandurbar?
faq.answer: One post of Medical Officer (Clock Hour Basis) is advertised at Govt. College of Agriculture, Nandurbar.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the MPKV Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The application must be sent to the Associate Dean on or before 16 November 2026, or handed in during office hours.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the MPKV Medical Officer (Clock Hour Basis) post?
faq.answer: An MBBS or BAMS degree from a recognized medical institute is the essential qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the MPKV Medical Officer (Clock Hour Basis)?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 1500/- per hour, up to a maximum of Rs. 25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the MPKV Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates pay a processing fee of Rs. 500/- online to the account of "Comptroller, MPKV, Rahuri", Account No. 3335577362, Central Bank of India, Nandurbar (IFSC CBIN0282185), and attach the receipt to the application.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the MPKV Medical Officer (Clock Hour Basis) post?
faq.answer: Write the application on plain paper as per the enclosed proforma, attach the documents and fee receipt, and send it to the Associate Dean, Govt. College of Agriculture, Nandurbar, Dhule Road, Tal., Dist. Nandurbar, Pin code 425-412 (MS), or hand it in during office hours.

faq.question: Q7. How will the MPKV Medical Officer be selected?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates will be interviewed by a Selection Committee approved by the University. Candidates attend at their own cost and must produce all original documents.

faq.question: Q8. Is the MPKV Medical Officer job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely temporary on contractual basis, initially for six (06) months, and can continue on satisfactory performance. The candidate cannot claim permanency benefits.

faq.question: Q9. Is any bond required for the MPKV Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Yes. The candidate has to submit an undertaking on Rs. 100/- bond paper accepting all the terms and conditions prescribed.
